title: AI & Data Engineering Intern
description:
Role: AI & Data Engineering Intern

 Employment Type: Intern

 Educational Qualification: Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, Engineering, Physics, or a related field.



 Role Description: 

 We are seeking an AI & Data Engineering intern to support the development of Pixxel's geospatial intelligence platform for maritime and land domain awareness. This platform fuses multi-source satellite imagery and sensor data into a unified operational picture, enabling defense and national security missions to detect, monitor, and reason about activity across maritime and land environments. This is a hands-on internship where you will work across the full stack: from data ingestion and preprocessing pipelines, through AI model development, to analyst-facing interfaces that make geospatial intelligence actionable.

 


 Responsibilities & Duties: 

 Data Pipelines & Infrastructure:

  Design and build scalable data pipelines for ingestion, preprocessing, and fusion of heterogeneous geospatial data sources, including optical satellite imagery, SAR, and vessel tracking telemetry (AIS), enabling efficient handling of multi-sensor, multi-temporal datasets.

 Establish consistent data standards and quality control processes across geospatial data feeds, ensuring alignment, georeferencing accuracy, and metadata integrity for downstream analytics.

 Build infrastructure for near-real-time geospatial data workflows, supporting continuous ingestion, scene-level processing, chip generation, and dataset export for model training and inference.

 Develop monitoring and evaluation tools to assess data pipeline performance, data quality, and throughput, ensuring reliable operation across large-area, persistent surveillance use cases.

  AI & Machine Learning

  Apply transformer architectures to geospatial problems, including object detection, classification, and scene understanding in overhead imagery across both maritime and land domains.

 Develop and fine-tune vision-language models (VLMs) that enable natural language reasoning over geospatial data, allowing analysts to query, describe, and interpret imagery-derived insights through conversational or programmatic interfaces.

 Explore diffusion model approaches for geospatial tasks, including image generation, super-resolution, and synthetic data augmentation to improve model performance in data-sparse or adversarial scenarios.

 Build multi-modal fusion pipelines that combine optical imagery, SAR, AIS, and other sensor feeds to detect anomalous activity, classify vessel behavior, and identify changes in the operational environment.

 Benchmark and validate models against ground truth datasets and operational evaluation metrics, iterating on architectures and training strategies based on performance feedback from analyst workflows.

  Cross-Functional Responsibilities

  Write clean, efficient, and maintainable Python code for data processing and model development. Contribute to shared utilities and machine learning libraries used across the team.

 Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams by:

 Providing feedback on data quality and annotation issues across geospatial datasets.

 Partnering with the ML team on model evaluation and performance improvements.

 Coordinating with data engineers to optimize ingestion and preprocessing pipelines.

 Documenting datasets, models, pipelines, and technical processes comprehensively to ensure reproducibility and provide clear technical insights for team members and end users.

  Desirable Skills & Certifications:

 


  Strong programming skills in Python with hands-on experience using libraries and frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, NumPy, Pandas, or equivalent.

 Solid understanding of deep learning fundamentals, including Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), attention mechanisms, transformer architectures, loss functions, optimization techniques, and evaluation metrics.

 Familiarity with vision-language models (VLMs), diffusion models, or multi-modal learning, with coursework, projects, or research experience in any of these areas.

 Practical experience or strong academic coursework in data pipelines, data processing, or data engineering workflows.

 Basic understanding of the end-to-end machine learning lifecycle, including model training, evaluation, and deployment at scale.

 Familiarity with geospatial or remote sensing data, including overhead imagery analysis, SAR, or vessel tracking datasets, is a plus but not required.

 Ability to work independently on well-defined workstreams, take ownership of deliverables, and proactively seek guidance from senior scientists when needed.

 Strong attention to detail, with an understanding that high-quality data is critical to model performance.

 Eagerness to learn quickly, adapt to new challenges, and thrive in a mission-driven, fast-paced environment.

  Candidate Acumen: 
You will own end-to-end workstreams across two primary areas: (1) Data & Infrastructure - building scalable pipelines for ingestion and fusion of multi-source geospatial data (optical, SAR, AIS, and other sensor feeds), establishing data quality standards, and supporting near-real-time analytical workflows; and (2) AI/ML - applying transformer architectures, vision-language models, and diffusion techniques to maritime and land domain awareness problems, including object detection, anomaly detection, and multi-modal sensor fusion, as well as building the agentic interfaces that allow analysts to query and reason about geospatial intelligence outputs. This is a hands-on role that bridges data engineering and deep learning - you will work closely with senior scientists and ML engineers on the platform team.

 Benefits:
Health insurance coverage
Unlimited leaves & flexible working hours
Role-based remote work and work-from-home benefit
Relocation assistance
Professional Mental Wellness services
Creche facility for primary caregivers (limited to India)
Employee Stock Options for all hires

 About Pixxel Pixxel is a space data company and spacecraft manufacturer redefining Earth observation with hyperspectral imaging. The company’s first three commercial hyperspectral satellites—Fireflies—deliver imagery at 5-meter resolution and 135+ spectral bands, providing 50x richer detail than traditional Earth observation systems and unlocking insights across agriculture, climate, energy, environment, and more.

 


 Once fully deployed, Pixxel’s constellation of 18-24 satellites will capture imagery across up to 250 bands in VNIR and SWIR ranges, with a 40 km swath and daily global revisit capability. Pixxel’s most unique strength is its full-stack approach, integrating every layer of the value chain from satellite hardware and manufacturing to AI-powered analytics.

 


 Pixxel’s satellite constellation is complemented by Aurora, its in-house Earth Observation Studio that simplifies satellite imagery analysis and democratises remote sensing for all. Designed to make hyperspectral data more accessible, Aurora by Pixxel combines high-frequency imagery with AI-powered tools to generate actionable insights, even for users without technical backgrounds. The third pillar of Pixxel’s ecosystem is its in-house satellite manufacturing capability. Beyond building its own spacecraft, Pixxel also provides satellite systems and subsystems to other organisations. This dual capacity sets it apart in a sector where most companies focus on either payload design or data operations, but not both.

 


 Pixxel’s team is young but deeply mission-aligned, with a culture rooted in curiosity, speed, and long-term thinking. As the company grows its constellation and expands Aurora, the focus remains on making space-based insights practical, scalable, and genuinely helpful so that the health of the planet becomes measurable and action becomes possible.

 


 Pixxel was the only Indian startup selected for the Techstars Starburst Space Accelerator in Los Angeles and has been recognised in TIME’s Best Inventions of 2023, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Via Satellite’s Top Innovators list.

 


 For more information, see our Careers page or follow Pixxel on LinkedIn and X/Twitter.

 


 Culture

 Pixxel is an organization where we enable our employees to work on world-changing problems that they are passionate about, and a place where they can be their best selves day in and day out while ensuring they have fun every day.

 


 Central to our employee-first ethos is a commitment to ensuring that every team member feels valued and heard. We nurture a healthy and supportive work environment where we prioritise well-being and growth in all aspects of life

description:
Location

About Future AGI
Future AGI is an AI lifecycle platform designed to support enterprises throughout their AI journey.
We combine rapid prototyping, rigorous evaluation, continuous observability, and reliable deployment to help organizations build, monitor, optimize, and secure generative AI applications.
We're working to make GenAI accessible to all?so building with AI becomes as common as writing code.


Our platform powers everything from LLM evaluation and agent simulation to real-time guardrailing and prompt optimization.


The Opportunity
This role starts where it matters most: with real customers solving real problems.
You'll work closely with our customer and solutions team on applied AI implementations?helping developers integrate Future AGI into their production systems, debugging tricky edge cases, and figuring out what actually works in the wild. You'll see firsthand how teams are building with LLMs, where they get stuck,
and what makes the difference between a proof of concept and production.


Then you'll take everything you learn and turn it into resources that help the next thousand developers succeed: open-source SDKs, cookbooks, demos,


blog posts, and videos that make complex AI concepts easier to understand.


This is the loop: customer work learnings better tools content more developers succeed repeat.


You're not building in a vacuum?you're building from the trenches.


And if you crush itThis internship is a direct path to a full-time role.


We're building our developer experience function from the ground up, and you could become a foundational part of it.


What You'll Do
Work with Customers (Applied AI)

Partner with the customer and solutions team to help developers integrate Future AGI into their AI applications.

Support real-world implementations by debugging issues, answering technical questions, and unblocking customers.

Learn how production AI systems work, including evaluation pipelines, observability setups, and guardrailing configurations.

Identify recurring customer pain points and opportunities to improve the developer experience.


Build Maintain Open-Source SDKs

Contribute to and maintain open-source SDKs for Python, Node.js, and other languages.

Improve SDK usability based on customer feedback and real-world usage.

Write clean, well-documented, and developer-friendly code.

Review community contributions, triage GitHub issues, and engage with developers.

Build integrations with AI frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, and more.


Turn Learnings into Content

Create production-ready cookbooks and code examples from real customer use cases.

Build end-to-end demos and sample applications showcasing Future AGI.

Record tutorials, walkthroughs, and technical explainer videos.

Write blog posts and technical guides that simplify complex AI concepts.

Maintain and continuously improve product documentation.


Shape the Developer Experience

Share customer feedback with product and engineering teams.

Test new features early, identify issues, and improve usability.

Engage with the developer community on GitHub, Discord, and Twitter/X.

Represent Future AGI at meetups, conferences, and online events when possible.

 What We're Looking For
Required

Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.

Strong programming skills in Python and willingness to learn additional languages such as JavaScript, TypeScript, or Go.

Hands-on experience with LLMs and AI frameworks including OpenAI, Anthropic, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Comfort working directly with customers and solving technical problems.

Self-driven mindset with the initiative to identify and create valuable solutions.


Nice to Have

Experience contributing to or maintaining open-source projects.

Experience in customer-facing or developer support roles.

Experience creating technical content such as blogs, tutorials, documentation, or videos.

Knowledge of SDK design patterns and developer tooling best practices.

Experience with video recording and basic editing tools.

Participation in developer communities such as GitHub, Discord, Stack Overflow, or Twitter/X.

Understanding of AI evaluation, observability, or MLOps concepts.

An existing portfolio or audience for technical content.

 What It Takes to Thrive Here

Love helping developers ? You enjoy solving problems and enabling others to succeed.

Care about craftsmanship ? Clean APIs, thoughtful documentation, and great developer experiences matter to you.

Learn by doing ? You prefer solving real-world challenges over theoretical exercises.

Build and share ? You enjoy creating projects and teaching others how they work.

Move fast and iterate ? You value shipping quickly and improving through feedback.

Handle ambiguity ? You can transform vague ideas into practical solutions.

Stay curious ? You're excited to explore new AI technologies and continuously learn.

 Why This Could Be the Best Decision You Make

Learn from real customer problems ? Gain hands-on experience building production AI systems.

Own open-source tools ? Maintain SDKs used by developers worldwide.

Full-stack impact ? Work across customer success, engineering, documentation, and product.

Build your personal brand ? Publish code, tutorials, videos, and blogs under your name.

Work at the frontier of AI ? Build expertise in LLM observability, evaluation, and guardrailing.

Path to full-time ? High-performing interns are considered for full-time opportunities.

Flexibility ? Remote-friendly, async-first, and focused on outcomes rather than hours.

Ground-floor opportunity ? Help shape the developer experience team as the company grows.

title: AI intern
description:
Role description


AI Intern - Marketing





RippleHire is building the ATS where humans and agents work together. Last year, RippleHire processed 86 million+ candidates across 50+ countries, counting as clients from 2000 employee orgs to 200,000+ employee orgs. We're profitable, and have built a leadership position in IT Services, BFSI, and Professional Services - and we are scouting for an AI intern who will help build AI GTM models and workflows. Internship duration: 3-6 months, full time





What you will do





Depending on the duration of your engagement, you will own one or more of the following workstreams:





Predictive account intelligence


Build classification models that score accounts and leads against patterns derived from historical conversion data


Incorporate firmographic, behavioural, and technographic signals into feature engineering pipelines


Integrate outputs into CRM as live scoring fields consumed by the sales team daily





Unstructured data extraction


Design and evaluate LLM-based pipelines that read conversation transcripts and extract structured insights


Benchmark few-shot vs fine-tuned approaches; choose the right method for accuracy and cost


Build evaluation frameworks so output quality is measurable, not subjective





Buying signal detection


Identify external signals that indicate a target company is in-market for solutions like ours


Build pipelines that aggregate, score, and surface these signals to outbound teams on a regular cadence


Validate signal reliability against actual conversion outcomes over time





Pipeline analytics


Model deal progression using time-series and survival analysis techniques on CRM event data


Identify leading indicators of deal slippage or acceleration


Produce actionable outputs - not just notebooks, but s and dashboards designed for real time use





What we are looking for





Recent grad or final year student preferably at IIT/NIT


Strong foundations: Proficiency in Python, coursework or projects in ML, NLP, or applied statistics


Builder mindset: You are comfortable working with real world messy, large data sets. You can communicate your findings to non-technical stakeholders in plain language


Nice to have: Prior exposure to B2B, SaaS, or enterprise software contexts — even through internships or projects. Experience with LLM APIs, prompt engineering, or RAG architectures





What you will get





End-to-end ownership of a real project - from problem framing through production deployment


Direct mentorship from the Head of Marketing and close interaction with the product, and engineering teams


A published case study of your work (with appropriate confidentiality) that you can use in placements or grad school applications


Competitive stipend


Fast-track consideration for a full-time role upon graduation for exceptional performers





Share your story


Send a short note (300 words or fewer) to saritha.fernandes@ripplehire.com that answers two questions:





Which of the four workstreams above would you pick, and why?


What is one real dataset or project you have worked on that is most relevant — and what did you learn from it that you would not have learned from a textbook?





Attach your resume and any links to code, papers, or public work. We read everything that comes in and respond to every application.
